thread:
Alex Chen: FYI customer reports truncated completions and a billing spike after a long chat session. Ticket INC-4321. Can we collect a repro bundle and scrub PII before forwarding?
Maria Gonzalez: Got it — can you paste the request IDs and rough timestamps? I can start a debug bundle once we have IDs.
Alex Chen: Request IDs: req_20260317_0412a, req_20260317_0413b. Approx time window: 2026-03-17T04:12:10Z - 04:13:05Z. Customer attached the prompt; contains names/emails.
Kevin Patel: I can try a curl repro. Customer said they used streaming & a long context (~6k tokens). Here's a masked curl we can use for repro — swap in a sanitized prompt:
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLACED_API_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"open-llm-30b","stream":true,"input":"<SANITIZED_PROMPT>"}'
```
Kevin Patel: For the debug bundle, please capture: server request logs for those IDs, the trace id, response sizes, and billing token counts. Do not upload raw prompt until scrubbed.
Support Bot: debug-bundle-service started collection for thread 1909876543 — bundle id dbg_20260317_99. Upload pending: secure-bucket://redwood-support/INC-4321/dbg_20260317_99 (private link expires in 7d).
Jamie Park: Quick q for Legal: is pseudonymization (replace names/emails with consistent PHIDs) enough, or do we need full redaction? Customer is OK with pseudonyms if mapping stays internal.
Priya (Legal): Pseudonymization is OK for triage (consistent but irreversible mapping preferred). Requirements: remove or hash direct identifiers (names, emails, phone numbers, IPs). Keep original request ids and timestamps but store a hash-mapping locally (not in the bundle). Example guidance: replace "John Doe" -> "user_7f3a2" or use sha256("John Doe")[:8].
Alex Chen: Plan: 1) Run local script to replace PII in prompt and attachments with deterministic pseudonyms. 2) Produce a small mapping file (hash only) and store it in our ticket system (not in the bundle). 3) Attach sanitized prompt to debug bundle and include request IDs.
Maria Gonzalez: Here's a quick python snippet I'm using to pseudonymize prompts (works offline):
```bash
echo 'original prompt here' | python3 -c "import sys,hashlib; s=sys.stdin.read(); print(hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:8])"
```
Maria Gonzalez: For practical redaction: run prompt through a whitelist replace: names/emails/ips -> <USER_xxx>. Keep tokens counts similar to preserve billing/latency repro.
Kevin Patel: I'll try the curl with <SANITIZED_PROMPT> and stream options to reproduce truncation. If I hit the same billing token spike I'll note exact token counts and attach stdout/stderr to dbg_20260317_99.
Support Bot: Upload link for scrubbed bundle created: secure-bucket://redwood-support/INC-4321/dbg_20260317_99/sanitized (expires in 7d). Access restricted to support+eng.
Jamie Park: Checklist before upload: 
- [ ] Remove PII from prompt and attachments
- [ ] Verify request id(s) present in bundle
- [ ] Hash mapping stored in ticket, not in bundle
- [ ] Mask API keys & tokens in logs (replace with REDACTED_TOKEN)
- [ ] Confirm legal ok (Priya)
Alex Chen: I'm doing the scrub now. Will paste the sanitized prompt snippet here for a quick signoff before upload.
Maria Gonzalez: One more note on logs: replace full Authorization headers and session cookies, but keep header names present so we can repro auth-handling issues.
Priya (Legal): Confirmed — that approach is compliant for support triage. Keep the mapping offline.
Alex Chen: Pasted sanitized prompt (example): "Dear support, user_01 reported that the assistant truncated after 2 responses. Conversation head: <REDACTED_USER_HISTORY_SNIPPET>."
Maria Gonzalez: Looks good. Kevin, when you attach your curl stdout, also include a tiny summary: tokens_sent, tokens_returned, latency_ms. That speeds triage.
Kevin Patel: Will do. If I reproduce, I'll upload logs to the secure link and update INC-4321 with dbg_20260317_99.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — after upload I'll mark the ticket handoff to eng-runtime for latency + billing analysis.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks all :thumbsup:
Support Bot: Note: bundle dbg_20260317_99 processing completed. Next step: eng-runtime review assigned.
